releaseNotes: Hold a card in Continue Watching to mark it watched or unwatched, alongside Remove. Includes 1.4.66: cloud sync no longer clears your place in anything you had not finished, so a film or episode you left partway through on your phone resumes here instead of starting over. A stream that fails to load is no longer recorded as watched, and the app waits for its channel list before syncing, which could otherwise replace channel names with numbers on your other devices. Update from Settings - Check for Updates.
